resources.string: System follows your phone\'s dark mode. Black is Dark on true black: whichever background you picked, its colors and patterns stay, quieter, over black. System and Light keep the black you picked last: pick Black, then System, for black pages at night.

Three parts, numbered in the preview: ① the light, ② the accent and ③ the background (under Pages). The preview shows your Prism in dark and in light, and changes the moment you pick. Each group\'s ⓘ says everything it changes in the app.
Album, playlist and artist pages use their picture\'s color instead (Page colors, under Pages).
Home has the %1$s background (Screen backgrounds, below), drawn over this color, so it shows little or not at all there.
With Theme on Black, dark pages stay black; the tint then shows on cards and in light mode.
